title: Dungeon Fighter II Tournament
description: Dungeon Fighter II Tournament — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Slay 15 Ice Orok Runts and 15 Toxic Mutant Pincers in lower Widow's Nest

Quest Reward: 4125 Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: Unknown

This quest was only offered after reaching level 33.
